Give Your Gold Jewellery the Care It Needs

Regular use can leave gold jewellery looking dull, while everyday wear may loosen fittings or cause damage. At SM Gold, you can bring your piece to our shop in 1st Floor, Alfalah Market, Sarafa Bazar, Sargodha and discuss suitable polishing, cleaning or repair options with our team.

Every piece is different. The right approach depends on its condition, construction, design and any stones or other materials it contains. We recommend an assessment before deciding what work should be carried out.

01 · Appearance and care

Gold Jewellery Polishing

Gold jewellery can lose some of its original shine through regular handling and contact with cosmetics, dust and other everyday substances. Ask us to assess whether cleaning or polishing is suitable for your item and its finish.

  • Assessment of dull or marked gold surfaces
  • Discussion of an appropriate finish
  • Care guidance for maintaining your jewellery
02 · Condition and function

Gold Jewellery Repair

A damaged or loose component can make a favourite piece difficult or unsafe to wear. Bring it in so we can inspect the issue and discuss whether a repair is practical for its design and condition.

  • Broken or damaged chain links
  • Loose or damaged clasps and fittings
  • Bent rings, bangles or other components
03 · Pieces you wear often

Ring, Bangle and Chain Care

Rings, bangles, bracelets and chains can experience different types of wear. We can look at the piece, discuss the issue and explain the options that may be appropriate before you decide how to proceed.

  • Gold rings and bands
  • Bangles and bracelets
  • Chains, necklaces and pendants
04 · Assessment first

Advice Before Work Begins

Not every mark needs polishing, and not every damaged item can be repaired in the same way. We encourage customers to discuss the piece first so the proposed work, estimated cost and expected timing can be explained.

  • Review of the jewellery's condition
  • Discussion of possible work
  • Cost and timing considered before proceeding
Please note: Repair options, cost and completion time depend on the individual item and the work required. Pieces with gemstones, delicate settings, soldered details or previous repairs may need special consideration. Final advice is given after inspection.

Helpful Customer Guidance

Before You Bring Gold Jewellery for Repair

A few useful precautions

  • Keep damaged chains or loose components safely stored so small parts are not lost.
  • Do not try to join broken gold jewellery with household glue or unapproved chemicals.
  • Tell us if the item contains gemstones, pearls, enamel or delicate detailing.
  • Share any previous repair history that you know about.
  • Ask for the proposed work and cost before authorising a repair.

How to care for gold jewellery

  • Store pieces separately to reduce rubbing and scratches.
  • Keep jewellery away from bleach, harsh cleaners and direct contact with household chemicals.
  • Remove jewellery before activities that may bend, pull or damage it.
  • Have loose clasps or settings checked rather than continuing to wear a damaged piece.
  • Avoid unnecessary polishing; ask whether cleaning or another option is more appropriate.

Frequently Asked Questions

Gold Polishing & Jewellery Repair FAQs

Do you provide gold jewellery polishing in Sargodha?

SM Gold offers gold polishing and repair enquiries at its Sarafa Bazar shop. Bring your item for an assessment so the team can advise whether polishing is suitable for its condition and finish.

Can a broken gold chain or damaged clasp be repaired?

Some chain and clasp issues may be repairable, depending on the damage, construction and condition of the piece. The item needs to be inspected before a repair can be confirmed.

How much does gold jewellery repair cost?

The cost depends on the type of jewellery, the extent of the damage, the work involved and any parts required. Contact us or visit the shop for an assessment and a discussion of the expected cost.

How long does jewellery polishing or repair take?

Timing depends on the item's condition and the type of work needed. We can discuss an expected timeframe after examining the jewellery; no fixed completion time is promised for every item.

Can all scratched or dull gold jewellery be polished?

Not always. The design, surface, thickness, previous polishing and any stones or decorative details can affect what is suitable. An assessment helps determine the safest practical option.

Where is SM Gold located?

SM Gold is located at 1st Floor, Alfalah Market, Sarafa Bazar, Sargodha. You can contact the shop before visiting to discuss your jewellery and the service you need.
